Spiritual Leader Pujya Gurudevshri Rakeshji Celebrates 60th Birthday

Spiritual leader Pujya Gurudevshri Rakeshji has turned 60. Mumbai will host an event called 'Aho Gurudev' to mark the occasion, featuring 60 new spiritual and service initiatives.
